about: W2b relation fixture, v2 extension (D-076 hold-out failure modes; self-authored, G-LIVE-B only). Same format as relations.json; gold uses the v2 labels: relation none | duplicate (near-identical text only) | relates (the same claim restated: a paraphrase or translation) | refines (+ gold refiner: the item that adds the detail) | contradicts (+ supersedes, + gold scope: whole = every statement of the replaced item is outdated, part = only one of several statements). Pairs with a doc_chunk raise contradictions only. class: contra_part | contra_whole_multi | contra_whole | dup_strict | relates | refines_old | refines_new | doc_contra | doc_same | near_miss | none.

new.title: Cache TTL raised
new.text: Since June the API cache TTL is 300 seconds.

existing.title: Cache setup
existing.text:
The API cache TTL is 60 seconds.
The cache is stored in Redis 7 on the api host.
Cache keys are prefixed with the tenant id.

existing.title: CDN cache
existing.text: The CDN caches static images for 7 days.

existing.title: Session store
existing.text: Sessions are kept in Redis for 30 minutes.

new.title: Yedek saklama süresi
new.text: Ağustos'tan beri veritabanı yedekleri yalnızca 14 gün saklanıyor.

existing.title: Yedekleme düzeni
existing.text:
Veritabanı her gece 03:30'da yedeklenir.
Yedekler 30 gün saklanır.
Yedekler şifrelenerek Hetzner Storage Box'a yüklenir.

existing.title: Log saklama
existing.text: Uygulama logları 7 gün saklanır.

existing.title: Restore drill
existing.text: A restore drill runs once a month on a scratch database.

new.title: Worker-Threads erhöht
new.text: Seit September nutzt der Embedding-Worker 4 Threads.

existing.title: Embedding-Worker
existing.text:
Der Embedding-Worker nutzt 2 Threads.
Er läuft im Container hlmemo-worker.
Seine Logs gehen nach journald.

existing.title: API-Worker
existing.text: Die API läuft mit 2 uvicorn-Workern.

new.title: Staging moved
new.text: Staging moved: it is now a Hostinger KVM 2 in Vilnius running Ubuntu 26.04, and the Hetzner CX22 was deleted.

existing.title: Staging server
existing.text:
The staging server is a Hetzner CX22 in Nuremberg.
It runs Ubuntu 22.04.

existing.title: Production server
existing.text: Production runs on a Hostinger KVM 4 in Vilnius.

new.title: Lint before commit
new.text: Run make lint before every commit.

existing.title: Lint before commit (imported)
existing.text: Run make lint before every commit.

existing.title: Linting rule
existing.text: Before committing, always lint the code with the make target.

existing.title: Tests before release
existing.text: Run make test before every release.

new.title: Dedicated test database
new.text: HLM_TEST_DSN must point to a dedicated database: the test suite truncates every table.

existing.title: Test DSN
existing.text: HLM_TEST_DSN must point to a dedicated database; the test suite truncates every table!

existing.title: Test veritabanı
existing.text: HLM_TEST_DSN ayrı bir veritabanını göstermeli, çünkü test paketi tüm tabloları boşaltır.

existing.title: Protected databases
existing.text: Never run the suite against the hlm or hlm_verify databases.

new.title: Nightly backup
new.text: The database is backed up every night.

existing.title: Backup schedule
existing.text: The database is backed up every night at 03:30 Europe/Vilnius, and each backup is kept for 14 days.

existing.title: WAL archiving
existing.text: WAL segments are archived every 5 minutes.

existing.title: Pinned model revision
existing.text: Pin the embedding model download by its commit revision 614241f, so the vectors never change silently.

existing.title: Lock files
existing.text: Install Python dependencies only from uv.lock.

new.title: Tageslimit
new.text: Während der Entwicklung gilt eine LLM-Obergrenze von 10 $ pro Tag und 3 $ pro Stunde.

existing.title: LLM-Limit
existing.text: Während der Entwicklung gilt eine LLM-Obergrenze von 10 $ pro Tag.

existing.title: Wallet
existing.text: The OpenRouter wallet holds about 23 dollars.

new.title: Default librarian model
new.text: The default librarian model is openai/gpt-6-luna since D-066; deepseek is only the fallback.

existing.title: Librarian profile
existing.text: The default librarian model is deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash (D-019).

existing.title: Librarian container
existing.text: The librarian runs in its own container with 512 MiB of memory.

existing.title: Model choice
existing.text: Since D-066 the librarian defaults to openai/gpt-6-luna, with deepseek only as the fallback.

new.title: Deploy log
new.text: 2026-09-20: the production deploy target moved from Hetzner to the Hostinger KVM 4 (D-068).

existing.title: Deploy target
existing.text: Production is deployed to the Hetzner CX33 server.

existing.title: Deploy script
existing.text: deploy.sh builds the images on the server itself.

new.title: Question expiry
new.text: Unanswered librarian questions expire after 30 days.

existing.title: Librarian questions
existing.text:
Unanswered librarian questions expire after 14 days.
An expired question is never applied.
The owner can answer accept, reject or custom.

existing.title: Batch size
existing.text: An approval batch holds at most 25 open questions.
